## Declarations and implementations

```plato

    //==
    // # Matrix3x2 — the 2D affine map
    //
    // Add, Subtract, Multiply(scalar) and Divide(scalar) live in
    // `matrices-ops.library.plato`.

    // Three rows: the 2x2 linear block plus the translation row.
    RowCount(self: Matrix3x2): Integer => 3;

    // Two columns.
    ColumnCount(self: Matrix3x2): Integer => 2;

    // Element (row, column), zero-based.
    // Precondition: 0 <= row < 3 and 0 <= column < 2.
    ElementAt(self: Matrix3x2, row: Integer, column: Integer): Number
        => row == 0 ? (column == 0 ? self.Row1.X : self.Row1.Y)
         : (row == 1 ? (column == 0 ? self.Row2.X : self.Row2.Y)
                     : (column == 0 ? self.Row3.X : self.Row3.Y));

    // Every element negated, translation row included.
    Negative(self: Matrix3x2): Matrix3x2
        => (-self.Row1, -self.Row2, -self.Row3);

    // Every element reduced modulo the scalar.
    Modulo(self: Matrix3x2, scalar: Number): Matrix3x2
        => (self.Row1 % scalar, self.Row2 % scalar, self.Row3 % scalar);

    //==
    // # Matrix4x3 — the 3D affine map

    // Four rows: the 3x3 linear block plus the translation row.
    RowCount(self: Matrix4x3): Integer => 4;

    // Three columns.
    ColumnCount(self: Matrix4x3): Integer => 3;

    // Element (row, column), zero-based.
    // Precondition: 0 <= row < 4 and 0 <= column < 3.
    ElementAt(self: Matrix4x3, row: Integer, column: Integer): Number
        => row == 0 ? self.RowElement(self.Row1, column)
         : (row == 1 ? self.RowElement(self.Row2, column)
         : (row == 2 ? self.RowElement(self.Row3, column)
                     : self.RowElement(self.Row4, column)));

    // One component of a three-component row, by column index.
    RowElement(self: Matrix4x3, row: Number3, column: Integer): Number
        => column == 0 ? row.X : (column == 1 ? row.Y : row.Z);

    // Element-wise sum.
    Add(a: Matrix4x3, b: Matrix4x3): Matrix4x3
        => (a.Row1 + b.Row1, a.Row2 + b.Row2, a.Row3 + b.Row3, a.Row4 + b.Row4);

    // Element-wise difference.
    Subtract(a: Matrix4x3, b: Matrix4x3): Matrix4x3
        => (a.Row1 - b.Row1, a.Row2 - b.Row2, a.Row3 - b.Row3, a.Row4 - b.Row4);

    // Every element negated, translation row included.
    Negative(self: Matrix4x3): Matrix4x3
        => (-self.Row1, -self.Row2, -self.Row3, -self.Row4);

    // Every element scaled.
    Multiply(self: Matrix4x3, scalar: Number): Matrix4x3
        => (self.Row1 * scalar, self.Row2 * scalar, self.Row3 * scalar, self.Row4 * scalar);

    // Every element divided.
    Divide(self: Matrix4x3, scalar: Number): Matrix4x3
        => (self.Row1 / scalar, self.Row2 / scalar, self.Row3 / scalar, self.Row4 / scalar);

    // Every element reduced modulo the scalar.
    Modulo(self: Matrix4x3, scalar: Number): Matrix4x3
        => (self.Row1 % scalar, self.Row2 % scalar, self.Row3 % scalar, self.Row4 % scalar);

    //==
    // # MatrixN — runtime shape, row-major storage
    //
    // The shape travels with the value, so the binary operations take their
    // result shape from the left operand. Precondition on Add and Subtract: both
    // operands have the same shape.

    // The row count carried by the value.
    RowCount(self: MatrixN): Integer => self.NumRows;

    // The column count carried by the value.
    ColumnCount(self: MatrixN): Integer => self.NumColumns;

    // Element (row, column), zero-based, from the row-major component array.
    // Precondition: 0 <= row < NumRows and 0 <= column < NumColumns.
    ElementAt(self: MatrixN, row: Integer, column: Integer): Number
        => self.Components[row * self.NumColumns + column];

    // Spelled as explicit constructions rather than as bare tuples: a MatrixN
    // result that is still a tuple when the next expression reads a field off it
    // renders as a call on the field name (CS1955) once the shipping recipe turns
    // field reads into methods. Naming the type gives the field read something
    // to bind to.

    // Element-wise sum, in the shape of `a`.
    Add(a: MatrixN, b: MatrixN): MatrixN
        => (a.NumRows, a.NumColumns, a.Components.Zip(b.Components, (x, y) => x + y));

    // Element-wise difference, in the shape of `a`.
    Subtract(a: MatrixN, b: MatrixN): MatrixN
        => (a.NumRows, a.NumColumns, a.Components.Zip(b.Components, (x, y) => x - y));

    // Every element negated.
    Negative(self: MatrixN): MatrixN
        => (self.NumRows, self.NumColumns, self.Components.Map(x => -x));

    // Every element scaled.
    Multiply(self: MatrixN, scalar: Number): MatrixN
        => (self.NumRows, self.NumColumns, self.Components.Map(x => x * scalar));

    // Every element divided.
    Divide(self: MatrixN, scalar: Number): MatrixN
        => (self.NumRows, self.NumColumns, self.Components.Map(x => x / scalar));

    // Every element reduced modulo the scalar.
    Modulo(self: MatrixN, scalar: Number): MatrixN
        => (self.NumRows, self.NumColumns, self.Components.Map(x => x % scalar));

    //==
    // # Sparse and banded matrix readings
    //
    // Element access and the shape statistics of the storage forms declared in
    // `matrices.types.plato`. Element access on a sparse matrix is a sum over
    // the entries naming that position — the coordinate-list invariant — so a
    // position with no entry reads as zero and duplicate entries accumulate, and
    // concatenating two entry lists is exactly matrix addition.
    //
    // Only relations that follow from the field definitions appear here: factorizing
    // or solving these systems needs a numerical kernel this vocabulary does not
    // declare.

    //==
    // # Sparse element access
    //
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sparse_matrix#Coordinate_list_(COO)

    // The value at a zero-based position: the sum of the entries naming it,
    // and zero when no entry does.
    ElementAt(self: SparseMatrix, row: Integer, column: Integer): Number
        => self.Entries.Reduce(0.0, (total, e) =>
            total + (e.Row == row && e.Column == column ? e.Value : 0.0));

    // True when the position carries at least one stored entry. A stored entry
    // whose value is zero still counts as stored.
    IsStored(self: SparseMatrix, row: Integer, column: Integer): Boolean
        => self.Entries.Any(e => e.Row == row && e.Column == column);

    // True when the entry lies on the main diagonal.
    IsDiagonal(self: SparseMatrixEntry): Boolean
        => self.Row == self.Column;

    // True when the entry stores a zero: a position the coordinate list names
    // but does not actually populate, which counts as stored but not as a
    // non-zero.
    IsExplicitZero(self: SparseMatrixEntry): Boolean
        => self.Value == 0.0;
```
